MINISTRY OF SKILL DEVELOPMENT & ENTREPRENEURSHIP (MSDE) PRADHAN MANTRI KAUSHAL VIKAS YOJANA 4.0 (PMKVY) GUIDELINES 1. SCHEME OVERVIEW: PMKVY 4.0 is the flagship outcome-based skill training scheme of the Government of India. The objective is to encourage and promote skill development for the youth across the country by providing free-of-cost, industry-relevant technical training, assessment, and certification. 2. KEY SCHEME COMPONENTS: a) Short Term Training (STT): 200 to 600 hours of training for school/college dropouts and unemployed youth in National Skills Qualification Framework (NSQF) aligned courses. b) Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL): Assessment and certification of existing skills of individuals with prior learning experience to align them with NSQF standards. c) Special Projects: Customized training for marginalized groups, vulnerable communities, jail inmates, and strategic sectors. d) Future Skills: Specialized cutting-edge training in AI, Robotics, Mechatronics, 3D Printing, Drones, IoT, and Green Hydrogen.

PM KAUSHAL VIKAS YOJANA 4.0 (Page 2) 3. FINANCIAL ASSISTANCE & INCENTIVES: - 100% free training and assessment for candidates; all course fees paid directly by the Central Government to training providers. - Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) of post-placement stipend and conveyance allowance to certified candidates. - Accidental Insurance cover under Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY) for 3 years to all certified candidates. - Digital Skill Certificate and QR-code enabled badge accessible via Skill India Digital Hub (SIDH). 4. PLACEMENT & ENTREPRENEURSHIP SUPPORT: Mandatory Rozgar Melas and linkage with National Career Service (NCS) portal and Mudra loan schemes for self-employment.

MINISTRY OF HOUSING AND URBAN AFFAIRS (MoHUA) PM STREET VENDOR'S ATMANIRBHAR NIDHI (PM SVANIDHI) OPERATIONAL GUIDELINES 1. SCHEME PURPOSE: PM SVANidhi is a Central Sector micro-credit scheme launched to provide affordable working capital loans to street vendors to resume their livelihoods affected by the COVID-19 pandemic and transition into formalized credit systems. 2. TARGET BENEFICIARIES: All street vendors vending in urban areas as on or before March 24, 2020, possessing: - Certificate of Vending / Identity Card issued by Urban Local Bodies (ULBs). - Identified in vending surveys or Recommendation Letter (LoR) from ULB / Town Vending Committee (TVC). - Vendors from surrounding peri-urban and rural areas vending in urban limits.

PM SVANIDHI GUIDELINES (Page 2) 3. LOAN TRANCHES & PROGRESSIVE CREDIT: - 1st Tranche: Collateral-free working capital loan up to Rs 10,000/- with 1-year tenure. - 2nd Tranche: Enhanced loan up to Rs 20,000/- on timely or early repayment of 1st loan. - 3rd Tranche: Enhanced loan up to Rs 50,000/- on timely or early repayment of 2nd loan. 4. FINANCIAL INCENTIVES: - Interest Subsidy: 7% per annum interest subsidy credited directly to beneficiary account on quarterly basis for timely repayments. - Cashback on Digital Transactions: Monthly cashback incentive up to Rs 100/- (Rs 1,200 annually) for conducting digital receipts/payments via UPI / QR code. - No penalty for early repayment of loans.

MINISTRY OF MICRO, SMALL AND MEDIUM ENTERPRISES (MSME) PM VISHWAKARMA SCHEME - OPERATIONAL GUIDELINES 1. SCHEME VISION: PM Vishwakarma is a comprehensive Central Sector Scheme with an outlay of Rs 13,000 crore to provide end-to-end holistic support to traditional artisans and craftspeople who work with their hands and tools. 2. COVERED 18 TRADITIONAL TRADES: 1. Carpenter (Suthar) 2. Boat Maker 3. Armourer 4. Blacksmith (Lohar) 5. Hammer & Tool Kit Maker 6. Locksmith 7. Sculptor (Moortikar/Stone carver) 8. Goldsmith (Sonar) 9. Potter (Kumhaar) 10. Cobbler (Charmakar/Shoemaker) 11. Mason (Raajmistri) 12. Basket/Mat/Broom Maker/Coir Weaver 13. Doll & Toy Maker (Traditional) 14. Barber (Naai) 15. Garland Maker (Malakaar) 16. Washerman (Dhobi) 17. Tailor (Darzi) 18. Fishing Net Maker. 3. RECOGNITION & CERTIFICATION: - PM Vishwakarma Certificate and ID Card conferring official recognition as a certified Vishwakarma.

PM VISHWAKARMA SCHEME (Page 2) 4. COMPREHENSIVE BENEFIT PACKAGE: a) Skill Upgradation: - Basic Training of 5-7 days (40 hours) with Rs 500/- per day stipend. - Advanced Training of 15 days or more with Rs 500/- per day stipend. b) Toolkit Incentive: - Modern Toolkit incentive of Rs 15,000/- credited via e-Vouchers / DBT. c) Enterprise Credit Support (Collateral-Free): - 1st Tranche: Loan up to Rs 1,00,000/- with 18 months repayment tenure. - 2nd Tranche: Loan up to Rs 2,00,000/- with 30 months repayment tenure. - Concessional Interest Rate: Flat 5% interest rate (MoMSME pays 8% interest subvention). d) Digital Transaction Incentive: - Re 1 per digital transaction up to 100 transactions per month.
